label: Face
description: What a person's face looks like: two or three of its features, such as its shape, the eyes, nose, lips, jaw, brows, cheeks or the detail of the skin, in plain visible terms. Fits the person's drawn age
notes: Composed from the person.feature lists when the vocabulary loads: which features a face names is part of the draw, so faces differ in what is distinctive about them. Never praise ('pretty', 'striking'): every part says what is visible. A face with a feature only one sex has is drawn only when the pick says which (where={"presentation": ...}).
